name: KISS U
source:
KISS U takes place in a far-off future where humans no longer exist on Earth. In their place, magical creatures have sprung up and created a new civilization free from the conflicts and sorrows of days past. New Gaia is a place where demons, elves, and catkin live in harmony... and go to college!

This is your first year attending the prestigious KISS U, and you’ve got a heck of a year ahead of you. There’s plenty more than your studies to attend to, though: you’ve got a whole world of romance and MORE to explore. You’ll meet five potential dates, each of which are more than happy to show off their wild side. Charm your potential partner, and you’ll get plenty of spicy photos from them on your CHERRY Phone!

The technology of today vanished in an ancient apocalypse and New Gaian society has rebuilt without it... until now! Hex’s research into ancient tools powered by a “mysterious energy” helps create the CHERRY Phone; a device that can make calls, fire off texts... and also send images directly from the owner’s mind. There’s all sorts of ways that this ancient tech has made its way into the daily lives of New Gaia citizens... but could there be something more to these discoveries?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1348605097/kiss-u]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
《KISS U》的故事发生在遥远的未来，人类早已从地球上消失。取而代之的魔法生物建立了新的文明，摆脱了过去的冲突与悲伤。在新盖亚，恶魔、精灵和猫族和睦相处…还会一起上大学！

这是你进入名校KISS U的第一年，而精彩的一年正等着你。不过，除了学业，还有许多事情值得投入：整个浪漫世界，以及更多体验，都等待着你去探索。你会遇见五位潜在约会对象，每一位都很乐意展现自己狂野的一面。俘获心仪对象的芳心，你的“樱桃手机”上就会收到许多火辣照片！

当今的科技早已在古代的一场末日浩劫中消失，新盖亚社会在没有这些技术的情况下重建…直到如今！赫克斯研究了由某种“神秘能源”驱动的古代工具，促成了樱桃手机的诞生。这台设备可以打电话、发短信…还可以直接发送机主脑海中的图像。古代科技正以各种形式融入新盖亚居民的日常生活…但这些发现背后，是否还藏着更多秘密？

[摘自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1348605097/kiss-u]Kickstarter[/url]]
